node.title: KoalaBear m2 r2 full-V4 source genus drop
node.closure: source V4 deck group, conic-factorization alternative, and tame fixed-point Riemann-Hurwitz
node.statement: In the full-V4 (m,r,delta)=(2,2,4) row, let eta be the source-projection involution and a,c the two endpoint coordinate involutions. The degree-four W map has deck group <eta,a>. Conjugation by c fixes a and must exchange eta with eta*a: fixing eta would make the quartic coefficient map factor through a quadratic source quotient and return to the excluded line/conic branch. Tame V4 Riemann-Hurwitz then gives g(Gamma)=0 with two fixed points of a, or g(Gamma)=1 with none. Genus two and three are impossible; neither remaining regime is deleted or paid.
